messages:
Nico: Quick brain dump: propose "audit-token" promotion model. Local observers can cut traffic for <=30s; any promotion to STABLE needs central token. Goal: fast local protection + global consistency.

Aria: Sounds good. How to prevent noisy-tenants from dragging others?

Rahul: Policy table per-tenant with max_spill_pct and preferred_fallbacks. Router maps auth -> tenant policy locally.

sre-bot: deploy 3023456789: canary 'v4-lite' rolled to 0.8% at 09:12 UTC. Monitoring attached.

Maya: Cache warming: mirror 0.1% to fill KV and warm kernels. Mirror should skip long gens.

Nico: Fallback order: 1) cached prefix, 2) tenant pinned variant, 3) smaller quant variant, 4) hosted fallback. Each tagged in telemetry.

Aria: Split-brain: allow degraded mode when controller unreachable: reduce spill limits, disable promotions. Observers continue safe bailouts.

Rahul: Telemetry contract: emit tenant, variant_from, variant_to, reason_code, signal_weights. Also send compact output-hash for drift detection.

Maya: Ops runbook: on EMERGENCY_SPILL -> pause rollout, scale down variant, notify oncall with affected tenants, snapshot traces.

Nico: Action items: Rahul proto policy schema, Aria draft degraded-mode rules, Maya mirror filter prototype. I'll write RFC follow-up with state machine and audit flow.

Aria: Add chaos tests for controller loss and stale-cache scenarios.

Rahul: I'll start policy schema this afternoon.

Maya: +1. Thanks team :thumbsup:
